text:
sara: Pasting notes from the morning sync. We're trying to unify canary + A/B rollouts and make fallbacks more expressive than a single switch. Wanted feedback on 'fallback chains' idea.

 tom: Explain the chain idea in one line?

 sara: Chain = an ordered list of degradation actions (route-level cheaper model, cache-first, 95pct-graceful, full rollback) with thresholds per-step. Controller advances back along chain when signals degrade.

 nina: So not just binary fallback but graded mitigation. Love it. How do we avoid flip-flopping between chain states?

 tom: EWMA on signal + min_hold per chain_state. Also require a secondary signal for critical path (error rate + latency both exceed).

 sara: Precisely. Proposal: probe_agg_window=30s, smoothing_alpha=0.2, min_state_dwell=90s, dual_signal_required=true.

 dev-bot: uploaded sample policy: /tmp/fallback_chain_example.yaml

 nina: We need to think about coupling with autoscaler. If degrade reduces load, autoscaler might scale down and then controller thinks recovery is safe and ramps again -> oscillation.

 tom: Add scale_in_fence: pause recovery for scale_cooldown_sec after any scaling action. Also surface "recent_scale" flag in the decision provenance.

 sara: Good call. Also adding a global "safety_budget" per cluster that limits concurrent chain deviations (so too many routes don't pick degrade at once).

 nina: For user-visible observability: show current_chain_index, last_transition_reason, dwell_remaining, and a short history of last 5 transitions. Oncall can then see why a route is stuck.

 tom: Ops requirement: an emergency bypass that jumps to end-of-chain (full rollback) with an audit annotation. We should gate that to a role.

 sara: Agreed. Security/ops will own the bypass flag. Add TTL for bypass to avoid permanent stomping.

 nina: How to validate cheaper variants? We need preflight tests (synthetic smoke + perf) for each variant in the chain. Controller should only include variants with a signed validation token.

 tom: Implementation note: route policy model -> [primary, variant-A, variant-B] maps to chain entries. We'll need runtime routing table extension: entry = {id, type, metadata_token}.

 sara: Also want a simulation harness to run historical traces and measure "stability score" for a policy. Make this part of the PR checklist.

 dev-bot: Created ticket INF-2021: "fallback-chain simulation harness"

 nina: Defaults? I suggest small tenants: min_dwell=60s, chain=[cache-only, low-precision], hosted defaults more conservative: min_dwell=120s, chain adds short-circuit rollback.

 tom: For A/B experiments we must keep experiment integrity: ensure chain actions don't change experiment assignment unless absolutely necessary. Add "preserve_assignment: true" until the final rollback step.

 sara: Good point. We don't want to contaminate experiment metrics. Also require a special flag to allow assignment migration under an emergency.

 nina: One more: decision provenance must include the raw signals used (counts) and the computed EWMA so SRE can replay the decision logic.

 sara: Next steps -> I'll write the policy schema draft and attach a few example chains. tom will prototype routing table changes. nina will sketch the telemetry/UI surfaces. ops will review bypass and RBAC flows.

 tom: I'll also add unit tests for scale_fence interactions and a small e2e that injects flapping load to verify dwell prevents oscillation.

 ops: We'll prepare runbook text for oncall and add a maintenance flag to pause chains during infra work.

 sara: Thanks all. If nobody objects I'll open the RFC follow-up doc with schema and simulation plan tonight. :rocket:
